category_title: At-risk students who resist connecting home and school contexts
student_description: This student is an at-risk learner who actively resists sharing their home life in the traditional classroom, believing teachers cannot understand their reality. They default to providing superficial, unelaborated lists as a defense mechanism. They uniquely require out-of-classroom digital mediums to safely express their narratives and a teacher who models vulnerability through personal self-disclosure.

criteria.rationale: The student feels unsafe bridging home and school within the physical classroom and requires alternative, private spaces to communicate their reality.
criteria.check: The long-term plan incorporates asynchronous, out-of-classroom tools (e.g., digital platforms, take-home devices) for the student to document and share their home context.

criteria.rationale: The student has a negative school identity that must be interrupted by empowering them as the author of their own story.
criteria.check: The long-term plan includes a structured goal or project designed to help the student compose their own personal narrative, explicitly aiming to reposition them as a writer or creator.
